Map Quiz Review

How this works
  1. The ten maps come in order, starting with New York City.
  2. Score 100% on each map two times. Only perfect runs count. If you miss any place, just try again.
  3. After your second perfect run, the next map opens.
  4. Your progress is saved in this browser. Finish on the same device and browser, and don't use a private or incognito window, or your progress will be lost.
  5. When you finish all ten maps, type your name. Take one screenshot of your summary and upload it to Brightspace.
